guide.summary: An alga that makes food from light in bright places and eats sugar in the dark.
guide.biology: Some real algae can both make food from light and take in dissolved food, depending on how much light they get.
guide.rules: Lives in water and swims slowly, 0.35 cells per second, sensing up to 2 cells away. It has two modes and uses exactly one each tick. It starts in light mode if light is at least 0.35, otherwise in sugar mode; it switches to light mode when light reaches 0.35 and to sugar mode when light falls to 0.25 or below, and keeps its current mode in between. In light mode it turns carbon dioxide into half body and half sugar, releasing oxygen. In sugar mode it eats sugar using oxygen. It cannot use broth. Prey for Amoeba, Ciliate, Rotifer, Waterbear and Wheelgrazer.
guide.example: Turn on the day and night cycle with Turnleafs beside a sugar patch and watch them change modes at dusk and dawn.
